title: Emotion-Aware and Context-Grounded Dialogue Agents for Personalized Video Game Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2611.29372v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present ChatNPC, a game companion that dynamically personalizes its responses in real time based on players' emotional shifts to enhance user immersion. The model integrates sequential data, leveraging the dynamic nature of streams to benefit from player information, spoken lines, and in-game context. We leverage recent progress in LLMs' tool-calling capabilities to extract vital information from memory and recognize potential constraints for accurate reasoning, thereby tackling the complexity of NPC conversation scenarios. The task is divided into a game sentinel-guided agent (SeGent), a memory capability, and a chat planning tool for reasoning instantiation. The approach uses a lightweight game template as an information framework, with relevant details and a thorough reasoning layout. We conduct extensive experiments on a newly developed game dataset for in-game context NPC dialogue and demonstrate that ChatNPC sequentially capture

translated_title: 面向个性化电子游戏交互的情感感知与情境锚定对话智能体
translated_abstract: 我们提出了ChatNPC，这是一个游戏伴侣系统，能够根据玩家的情绪变化实时动态地个性化其回复，以增强用户沉浸感。该模型整合了序列数据，利用数据流的动态特性，从玩家信息、语音台词和游戏内上下文中获益。我们利用大语言模型（LLM）工具调用能力的最新进展，从记忆中提取关键信息并识别潜在约束以实现准确推理，从而应对NPC对话场景的复杂性。该任务被分解为游戏哨兵引导的智能体、记忆能力以及用于推理实例化的聊天规划工具。该方法使用轻量级游戏模板作为信息框架，其中包含相关细节和完整的推理布局。我们在一个新构建的游戏内上下文NPC对话数据集上进行了大量实验，并证明ChatNPC能够依次捕获……
tldr: 提出了ChatNPC，一个能根据玩家情绪变化实时个性化回复、结合记忆提取与游戏上下文推理的游戏NPC伴侣系统，有效增强玩家沉浸感。
en_tdlr: ChatNPC is an emotion-aware game companion that personalizes NPC responses in real time based on players' emotional shifts, leveraging memory retrieval and in-game context reasoning to enhance user immersion.
